issues.failure_explanation: The announced proof mechanism cannot apply. The displacement-convexity/LSI argument of malrieu2001logarithmic requires $\nabla^2V\succeq\alpha I$ ($\alpha>0$) and $\nabla^2W\succeq0$; on $\T^d$ no nonconstant periodic potential has a positive-semidefinite Hessian and no periodic $V$ can be uniformly convex, so the 'carried over the torus' route is vacuous. Moreover, the hypotheses actually stated in thm:equilibria (H-stability or small $\|W\|_\infty$) do not imply displacement convexity in any case. Hence thm:expconv (exponential $L^1$ convergence) is asserted with no valid derivation in the source, and the derivation attributed to thm:equilibria also fails (it retains only partial citation support).
